# 易緯辨終備

**ID:** KR1a0165
**Custom ID:** ZB1a0162
**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V53.6, p864
**Extent:** 1 卷

## Authors / Editors
- 鄭玄 (漢朝) 註

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The third of the eight *Yì wěi* 易緯 texts gathered as appendix to the *Yì*-class of the *Sìkù quánshū*; see [KR1a0163](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0163) for the broader contextualization of the *Yì wěi* tradition. Recovered from the *Yǒnglè dàdiǎn*. The work treats the *biàn zhōng bèi* — discriminating-the-end and preparedness — as a divinatory-cosmographic apparatus complementary to the *Jī lǎn tú* ([KR1a0164](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0164)). One juàn.

**Abstract**

The work is among the more compact members of the eight-text *Yì wěi* corpus. As with the rest of the corpus, the substantive content concerns Hàn-period divinatory-cosmographic apparatus drawn on the *Yìjīng*; the attribution to Zhèng Xuán's commentary is conventional rather than secure.
